Show the active brand settings

Source: R/brand.R
brand_info.Rd

Show the active brand settings

Usage

brand_info()

Value

An ezrsurvey_brand list with elements colors, color_primary, font_major, font_minor, template_pptx, template_docx (each NULL when unset).

See also

use_brand(), clear_brand().

Other brand: clear_brand(), pal_brand(), scale_fill_brand(), use_brand()

Examples

brand_info()
#> No brand set. See ?use_brand.
